faq.title: FAQ
faq.turnaround: What is your typical turnaround time?
faq.turnaround_ans: Most projects are delivered within 2-4 weeks, depending on scope and complexity. Enterprise projects may take 6-8 weeks.
faq.revisions_ans: All packages include unlimited revisions within the agreed scope. We work until you are 100% satisfied.
faq.tech_ans: We specialize in Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, Three.js, and various headless CMS solutions.
faq.maintenance_ans: Yes, we offer monthly maintenance packages that include updates, monitoring, security patches, and priority support.
faq.existing_design: Can you work with our existing design?
faq.existing_design_ans: Absolutely. We can implement your existing designs or create new ones from scratch based on your brand guidelines.
faq.seo_ans: Yes, all our builds include technical SEO best practices. We also offer ongoing SEO optimization packages.
faq.payment_ans: We require a 50% deposit to begin work, with the remaining 50% due upon completion and approval.
faq.international: Do you work with international clients?
faq.international_ans: Yes, we work with clients globally. We are experienced in remote collaboration across time zones.
